name: Spline
tagline: Collaborative 3D design tool with AI generation
description: Spline is a browser-based 3D design tool used to build interactive scenes for websites, products, and games. Its AI features include text-to-3D generation, AI texturing, and a code-export pipeline. Designers use it as a 3D Figma equivalent, with real-time collaboration and embeddable scenes.
pricingDetails: Free: 2 editors, public scenes. Super: $9/editor/month. Super Team: $14/editor/month.
